calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.brand,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS units,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rk_value,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.units) DESC) AS rk_units
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_keys, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids,
       min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity <= 0) AS nonpos_qty, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_amount <= 0) AS nonpos_net,
       count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load

WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

WITH top AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (100955),(100927),(103415),(103434),(102116),(101398),(103329),(101411),(101022),(101375),(101763),(103697),(101946)) t(sku))
SELECT p.sku, count(*) AS versions, sum(CASE WHEN p.is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows,
       string_agg(DISTINCT p.product_name, ' / ') AS names, string_agg(DISTINCT p.category, ' / ') AS cats,
       min(p.listed_from) AS listed, max(p.delisted_on) AS delisted,
       string_agg(CAST(p.standard_unit_cost AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY p.valid_from) AS costs
FROM dim_product p JOIN top USING (sku)
GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY p.sku

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sl AS (
    SELECT p.sku, s.store_id, f.receipt_id, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS bd, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.sale_date, f.channel_code,
           (w.web_order_id IS NULL AND s.store_id = 900) AS web_no_dispatch
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND NOT web_no_dispatch) AS sold_net,
  sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id=900 AND NOT web_no_dispatch) AS web_net,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND NOT web_no_dispatch) AS nlines,
  max(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND NOT web_no_dispatch) AS maxline,
  max(quantity) FILTER (WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND NOT web_no_dispatch) AS maxqty,
  sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS by_sale_date_net
FROM sl WHERE sku IN (100955,100927,103415,103434,102116,101398,103329,101411,101022,101375,101763,103697,101946,101888,103075)
GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sold_net DESC

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
nl AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT (SELECT sum(v) FROM nl WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS mine,
       (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id<>999) AS control,
       (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS control_all

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 11
